crossRefs.note: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with…
Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
Yahweh will save me. Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in Yahweh’s…
Yahweh, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music…
Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

translations.web: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
translations.bsb: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.
translations.kjv: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
translations.asv: Praise him with timbrel and dance: Praise him with stringed instruments and pipe.
